services.name: Ticket
services.desc: All visitors with public assistance cards are eligible for free admission for up to 5 people per card. Valid public assistance IDs include: WIC, EBT, SNAP, Medicaid, ProviderOne/Apple Health, or Registered Foster Family identification. Tickets to the National Nordic Museum range from $10-25, with the lowest price available when you purchase your ticket online. Walk-ins are always welcome, but we encourage you to purchase your ticket ahead of time to save time and money on the day of your visit.
